triggers.name: new_worker
triggers.title: New worker
triggers.help: When first started, all existing workers will be processed as individual jobs. Subsequently, triggers when a worker is created. Checks for new workers every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: name_filter
input.label: Name filter
input.hint: Use this to filter workers by name. At least 3 consecutive characters are required. The search is case-insensitive and matches worker names that start with the provided text.
